disclosures.text: Pipe pushing apparatus for connection to an excavator
a pair of jaws having cooperating pipe-gripping surfaces
a hydraulic ram coupled to the jaws
ram capable of actuating jaws to grip a pipe
a connection portion to connect to an excavator articulated arm
a hydraulic fluid distributor to distribute fluid from excavator auxiliary lines to the ram

Pipe pushing apparatus for connection to an excavator, having a pair of jaws with cooperating pipe-gripping surfaces, a hydraulic ram coupled to and actuating the jaws to grip a pipe, a connection portion to connect to an excavator articula
Excavator including pipe pushing apparatus, an articulated arm rigidly connected to the connection portion, and auxiliary hydraulic supply lines connected to the hydraulic fluid distributor
Kit of parts including pipe pushing apparatus and a plurality of pairs of removable and replaceable jaw liners, each pair having pipe-gripping surfaces of a different curvature

Method of pushing pipe using an excavator and apparatus, including connecting the apparatus to the excavator arm and hydraulic lines, distributing fluid to actuate jaws, and manipulating the arm to move the pipe
jaws pivotable about a pivot between first and second end portions
cooperating pipe-gripping surfaces each have an arcuate cross-section
each jaw includes a removable and replaceable jaw liner
connection portion is rotatable relative to the jaws
connection portion includes a locking mechanism for locking orientation
hydraulic fluid distributor has first and second hoses connectable to auxiliary line couplings
first hose distributes fluid to a first end of the ram
second hose distributes fluid to a second end of the ram
including a further pair of jaws with cooperating curved pipe-gripping surfaces
including two removable and replaceable jaw liners, one for each jaw of each pair
